# Python 实现：情感分析 {#sec-sentiment-python}

本章用 Python 重现第 \@ref(sec-sentiment) 章的内容：使用情感词典对文本进行情感分析。Python 端用 **pandas** 做数据操作，**nltk** 提供英文停止词和分词，**matplotlib** 绘图，**wordcloud** 生成词云。情感词典（AFINN、Bing、NRC）从统一导出的 parquet 读取。

## 情感词典

加载三个情感词典（AFINN、Bing、NRC），查看其结构。

```{python}
import pandas as pd

afinn = pd.read_parquet("data/common/afinn.parquet")
nrc = pd.read_parquet("data/common/nrc.parquet")
print("AFINN:", afinn.shape)
print(afinn.head())
print("\nNRC:", nrc.shape)
print(nrc.head())
```

```{python}
bing = nrc[nrc["lexicon"] == "bing"] if "lexicon" in nrc.columns else nrc
# 也单独导出了 afinn
print("AFINN 唯一情感值:", sorted(afinn["value"].unique()))
```

## 《红楼梦》英译本情感分析

从 parquet 读取《红楼梦》英译本，分词后进行情感分析。

```{python}
import re
import nltk
from nltk.corpus import stopwords

nltk.download("stopwords", quiet=True)
nltk.download("punkt_tab", quiet=True)
en_stopwords = set(stopwords.words("english"))

hongloumeng_en = pd.read_parquet("data/common/hongloumeng_en.parquet")
print(f"行数: {len(hongloumeng_en)}, 列: {list(hongloumeng_en.columns)}")
hongloumeng_en.head()
```

按上下半部分（book）和章节划分，展开为每行一词（等价于 R 的 `unnest_tokens`）：

```{python}
# 标记 book（上/下半部）
hongloumeng_en["book"] = (
    hongloumeng_en["text"].str.contains(r"HUNG LOU MENG, BOOK [I]+", regex=True, na=False).cumsum()
)

# 按行号标记 linenumber 和 chapter
def process_book(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["linenumber"] = range(1, len(df) + 1)
    df["chapter"] = (
        df["text"].str.contains(r"^chapter [\divxlc]", regex=True, na=False, case=False).cumsum()
    )
    return df

hongloumeng_en = hongloumeng_en.groupby("book", group_keys=False).apply(process_book)

# 分词
def tokenize(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    return [w.lower() for w in nltk.word_tokenize(text) if w.isalpha()]

words_list = hongloumeng_en["text"].apply(tokenize)
tidy_books = hongloumeng_en[["book", "linenumber", "chapter"]].copy()
tidy_books = tidy_books.assign(word=words_list).explode("word")
tidy_books = tidy_books[tidy_books["word"].str.len() > 0]
print(f"总词数: {len(tidy_books)}")
tidy_books.head()
```

### NRC 词典：最常见的"开心"词

```{python}
nrc_joy = nrc[nrc["sentiment"] == "joy"]

book1_joy = (
    tidy_books[tidy_books["book"] == 1]
    .merge(nrc_joy, left_on="word", right_on="word", how="inner")
)
book1_joy["word"].value_counts().head(10)
```

### Bing 词典：叙事过程中的情感变化

```{python}
# Bing 词典中 positive/negative 的词
bing_dict = nrc[nrc["sentiment"].isin(["positive", "negative"])]
# 去重（一个词可能同时标为 positive 和 negative）
bing_dict = bing_dict.drop_duplicates(subset=["word", "sentiment"])

net_sentiment = (
    tidy_books
    .merge(bing_dict, on="word", how="inner")
    .assign(index=lambda df: df["linenumber"] // 100)
    .groupby(["book", "index", "sentiment"])
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="n")
    .pivot(index=["book", "index"], columns="sentiment", values="n")
    .fillna(0)
    .reset_index()
)
net_sentiment["sentiment"] = net_sentiment["positive"] - net_sentiment["negative"]
net_sentiment.head()
```

绘制情感变化图（等价于图 \@ref(fig-sentimentplot)）：

```{python}
#| label: fig-sentimentplot-py
#| fig-cap: "《红楼梦》英译本叙事过程中的情感（Python）"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib

matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = ["Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei"]
matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5), sharey=False)
for ax, book in zip(axes, [1, 2]):
    sub = net_sentiment[net_sentiment["book"] == book]
    colors = ["#d62728" if s < 0 else "#2ca02c" for s in sub["sentiment"]]
    ax.bar(sub["index"], sub["sentiment"], color=colors, width=1.0)
    ax.set_title(f"Book {book}")
    ax.set_xlabel("Index (每100行)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Net sentiment")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 三个情感词典的比较

用 AFINN、Bing、NRC 三种词典分别计算下半部（book 2）的情感变化。

```{python}
book2 = tidy_books[tidy_books["book"] == 2].copy()
book2["index"] = book2["linenumber"] // 100

# AFINN：数值型情感分数
afinn_scores = book2.merge(afinn, on="word", how="inner")
afinn_by_index = afinn_scores.groupby("index")["value"].sum().reset_index()
afinn_by_index["method"] = "AFINN"

# Bing：二元分类
bing_scores = book2.merge(bing_dict, on="word", how="inner")
bing_by_index = (
    bing_scores.groupby(["index", "sentiment"]).size()
    .reset_index(name="n")
    .pivot(index="index", columns="sentiment", values="n")
    .fillna(0)
    .reset_index()
)
bing_by_index["sentiment"] = bing_by_index["positive"] - bing_by_index["negative"]
bing_by_index = bing_by_index[["index", "sentiment"]]
bing_by_index["method"] = "Bing et al."

# NRC：positive/negative 标签
nrc_posneg = nrc[nrc["sentiment"].isin(["positive", "negative"])]
nrc_scores = book2.merge(nrc_posneg, on="word", how="inner")
nrc_by_index = (
    nrc_scores.groupby(["index", "sentiment"]).size()
    .reset_index(name="n")
    .pivot(index="index", columns="sentiment", values="n")
    .fillna(0)
    .reset_index()
)
nrc_by_index["sentiment"] = nrc_by_index["positive"] - nrc_by_index["negative"]
nrc_by_index = nrc_by_index[["index", "sentiment"]]
nrc_by_index["method"] = "NRC"

compare = pd.concat([afinn_by_index, bing_by_index, nrc_by_index], ignore_index=True)
compare.head()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-compareplot-py
#| fig-cap: "用《红楼梦》英译本下半部比较三个情感词典（Python）"
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(10, 8), sharex=True)
for ax, method in zip(axes, ["AFINN", "Bing et al.", "NRC"]):
    sub = compare[compare["method"] == method]
    colors = ["#d62728" if s < 0 else "#2ca02c" for s in sub["sentiment"]]
    ax.bar(sub["index"], sub["sentiment"], color=colors, width=1.0)
    ax.set_title(method)
    ax.set_ylabel("Sentiment")
plt.xlabel("Index (每100行)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 最常见的正面词和负面词

```{python}
bing_word_counts = (
    tidy_books
    .merge(bing_dict, on="word", how="inner")
    .groupby(["word", "sentiment"])
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="n")
    .sort_values("n", ascending=False)
)
bing_word_counts.head(10)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-pipetoplot-py
#| fig-cap: "《红楼梦》英译本中正面和负面情感的词（Python）"
top10 = (
    bing_word_counts
    .groupby("sentiment")
    .apply(lambda g: g.nlargest(10, "n"))
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 5))
for ax, sent in zip(axes, ["positive", "negative"]):
    sub = top10[top10["sentiment"] == sent].sort_values("n")
    color = "#2ca02c" if sent == "positive" else "#d62728"
    ax.barh(sub["word"], sub["n"], color=color)
    ax.set_title(sent)
    ax.set_xlabel("Count")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 中文《红楼梦》词云

```{python}
hongloumeng = pd.read_parquet("data/common/hongloumeng.parquet")

import jieba

with open("data/stop_word_zh.utf8", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    stopwords_zh = set(line.strip() for line in f if line.strip())

def segment_zh(texts):
    result = []
    for t in texts:
        words = jieba.lcut(t) if isinstance(t, str) else []
        result.append([w for w in words if w.strip() and w not in stopwords_zh])
    return result

hongloumeng["words"] = segment_zh(hongloumeng["text"])
all_words = [w for ws in hongloumeng["words"] for w in ws]

from collections import Counter
word_freq = Counter(all_words)
word_freq.most_common(20)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-firstwordcloud-py
#| fig-cap: "《红楼梦》常见词云（Python）"
from wordcloud import WordCloud

wc = WordCloud(
    font_path="C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc",
    width=800, height=600,
    max_words=80,
    background_color="white"
)
wc.generate_from_frequencies(word_freq)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
ax.imshow(wc, interpolation="bilinear")
ax.axis("off")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## R vs Python 对比

| 任务 | R | Python |
|---|---|---|
| 情感词典 | tidytext `get_sentiments()` | pandas `read_parquet()` |
| 情感分析 | `inner_join(sentiments)` | `merge(sentiments)` |
| 情感统计 | `count(sentiment)` + `spread()` | `groupby()` + `pivot()` |
| 词云 | wordcloud2 | wordcloud |
| 句子分词 | `unnest_tokens(token="sentences")` | `nltk.word_tokenize()` |
| 绘图 | ggplot2 | matplotlib |

Python 的 nltk 分词基于英文，中文分词仍需 jieba。情感词典内容与 R 完全一致（同一 parquet 数据源）。
